subject.title: peekaboo daemon start times out ("did not start within 3s") while daemon run binds socket in ~1s

question: Should this daemon start timeout move through a macOS live-repro/debug pass before a fix PR is queued?
rationale: The source path and affected files are clear, but the real failure depends on detached process behavior on the reporter's macOS/Homebrew setup and the root cause is not proven from code alone.

options.title: Run macOS repro first
options.body: Have a maintainer or Crabbox-style macOS run capture the child exit/log behavior, then queue the narrow daemon launch fix with that evidence.

options.title: Queue diagnostics-first fix now
options.body: Accept source-level confidence and implement better child stderr/termination reporting before changing launch mechanics or timeout policy.

options.title: Wait for reporter follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not start repair work until the reporter provides additional logs or a local repro artifact.

recommendation.title: Run macOS repro first
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer or Crabbox-style macOS run capture the child exit/log behavior, then queue the narrow daemon launch fix with that evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent daemon and bridge lifecycle history and is best positioned to judge the macOS launch-path proof threshold.
